name: Alesjaure-Tjaktja
description: Alesjaure to Tjaktja. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: STF lists Alesjaure-Tjaktja as section 3, 13 km, while Naturkartan publishes Alesjaure-Salka as one 25 km route with Tjaktja as an intermediate cabin.
STF hut coordinates are official facility endpoints, but both Naturkartan cut line and OSM/Waymarked section line are about 216-220 m from the STF Tjaktja hut coordinate.
Naturkartan combined Alesjaure-Salka line is stored Salka-to-Alesjaure and must be reversed; API reportedly has publish_gpx=false while public GPX worked on 2026-04-29.
STF structured field says 11-25 beds, while STF Swedish text/rules lane and Naturkartan/OSM context indicate 33 beds.
Alesjaure has a large shop, but Tjaktja has no shop in STF stage/shop/facility evidence.
No named land reserve or national park was confirmed for this section, but possible Natura 2000 water-system relevance was noted and exact overlap was not verified.
Alesjaure/Tjaktja child amenities, wild tent areas, Meditationsplats and Tjaktja waterfall rely on OSM or field evidence rather than official object coordinates.

facilities.name: Hangbro Aliseatnu
facilities.description: 41 m suspension bridge at/near the Alesjaure start where the route crosses Aliseatnu.
facilities.routeProximity: About 86 m from combined GPX/start area.

facilities.name: Hangbro Ceavccanjira
facilities.description: 30 m suspension bridge near Tjaktja, with steep steel stairs on the east side according to the facilities lane.
facilities.routeProximity: Near Tjaktja hut/end area, just beyond the hut area relative to north-to-south travel.

facilities.name: STF Alesjaure Mountain Cabin
facilities.description: Large STF mountain cabin and remote trail junction at the section start, with guest kitchen, large shop, sauna, some pet rooms, safety-room/helpline context and 76-100 beds.
facilities.routeProximity: Section start; about 190 m from combined Naturkartan GPX mainline and about 6.5 m from Waymarked section start.

facilities.name: STF Tjaktja Mountain Cabin
facilities.description: Remote STF mountain cabin at the section end, high on the Kungsleden slope toward Tjaktja Pass. Services include guest kitchen, pet-room context, marked summer/winter trails nearby and safety-room/helpline context. No shop is listed by STF.
facilities.routeProximity: Section end hut; about 216-220 m from mainline/cut geometry.
